title: Macrostep Retargeting of a Setup Configuration
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $a$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a word over the schedule alphabet, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+3$ work tapes on input $x$. For optional phases $q,q'$, an input-head position $p$, integers $b,u,g,u',g'$, and tape-content functions $\beta,\mu,\gamma : \mathbb{Z} \to \text{Option}(\text{schedule alphabet})$, first form the setup configuration from $c$ with phase $q$, input-head position $p$, tape heads at $b,u,g$, and contents $\beta,\mu,\gamma$ on the last three tapes. Applying the macrostep construction to this configuration with phase $q'$ and unary-counter and guide head positions $u',g'$ gives exactly the setup configuration based on $c$ with phase $q'$, input-head position $p$, tape heads at $b,u',g'$, and the same tape contents and output.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$x$ is a word over the schedule alphabet
$c$ is a configuration with $k+3$ work tapes on input $x$
$\beta,\mu,\gamma$ map integers to optional schedule symbols
replaced:
Modifying a setup configuration by changing only its phase to $q'$ and its unary and
guide head positions to $u'$ and $g'$ --- keeping every tape, the budget head, and the
input head fixed --- again yields a setup configuration with the same remaining data.
